new_news.headline: Renewable Fuel from Food Waste: Darling Ingredients
new_news.summary: Interview with Darling Ingredients executive VP and CFO Bob Day discussing how the company turns agricultural waste into renewable fuel and profitable products. Discussion covered recent investor day emphasis on the renewable fuel standard RFS policy and the company's transformation through acquisitions.

new_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Highlights Growth in Renewable Fuels and Collagen
new_news.summary: Darling Ingredients held its 2026 Investor Day on May 11, highlighting its transformation into a global leader in rendering, collagen, and renewable fuels. The company emphasized Diamond Green Diesel and collagen demand as key growth drivers, with ~1.2 billion gallons of renewable diesel capacity and early adoption of sustainable aviation fuel.
